subject: SIG: Tenant segmentation / data separation — evidence request and clarifying questions
messages:
From: Alice Thompson <alice.thompson@lumenbank.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: LumenBank Procurement <procure@lumenbank.com>
Date: Thu, 07 Oct 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: SIG: Tenant segmentation and data separation evidence request

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for taking our SIG submission — we have a focused set of asks on multi-tenant separation for the evaluation team. Can you provide the following artifacts and clarifications?

1) A network/architecture diagram showing tenant segmentation boundaries (ingress, egress, VPCs, subnets).
2) Description of logical separation: are tenants separated by database instance, schema, row-level tagging, or other controls?
3) KMS/key management: do you use per-tenant keys, key isolation, and can you provide a key policy excerpt?
4) Evidence that cross-tenant access is not possible (access reviews, recent test results or pen-test excerpts).
5) Retention & deletion: description of tenant data retention and deletion process, with sample deletion logs.

We need this to complete the SIG control substantiation for our privacy and platform teams. Ideally we can get the artifacts by COB Monday (10/11) to stay on the procurement timeline. Redaction is acceptable if necessary.

If any of the items above are not applicable, please call out why. Happy to hop on a short call if that's easier.

Best,
Alice
Alice Thompson
Senior Vendor Risk Manager — LumenBank
--
LumenBank Procurement
procure@lumenbank.com
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Thompson <alice.thompson@lumenbank.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 07 Oct 2026 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG: Tenant segmentation and data separation evidence request

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear list. We can provide the artifacts you requested. Quick clarifying questions so we prepare exactly what's needed:

- For item (2), do you want a statement of architecture + a sample tenant isolation test (unit/integration test) or the last manual verification run from our SRE team?
- For (4), redacted access review logs are fine; do you need user-level events or just account/role-level attestations?
- For (5), do you require specific deletion proof per-tenant (example logs) or a process-and-sample approach?

Plan: I will coordinate delivery from security and infra. Karthik (security) and Mina (platform) are on-copy to own the artifacts. We will upload everything to a shared Drive folder and send a short inventory with control mappings (SIG questions -> artifact file).

We can meet Friday 10/8 at 11am PT if you'd like a quick walkthrough. Otherwise we'll aim to deliver redacted artifacts and a mapping spreadsheet by close of business Monday 10/11.

Regards,
Jasmine Liu
Sr. Security & Solutions, Redwood Inference

Forwarding the ask from LumenBank — they want segmentation proof + KMS policy + deletion samples. Can you each confirm what we can provide and estimated ETA?

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 07 Oct 2026 13:04:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: SIG: Tenant segmentation and data separation evidence request

Jasmine / Karthik — summary of what's available and proposed artifacts: 

1) Tenant isolation model: we use a hybrid model depending on customer tier — for standard hosted customers we use a single shared cluster with logical tenant isolation (tenant_id partitioning + row-level isolation enforced in service layer). For enterprise customers (Dedicated/Dual-tenant) we offer per-tenant namespace or dedicated DB instances.

Artifact: tenant-isolation-architecture-v2.pdf (diagram + explanation).

2) Database controls: row-level tagging, column-level encryption for PII at the application layer; role-based access checks in the service path and documented RBAC mapping.

Artifact: sample-schema-and-policy.txt (redacted) — we will include a short snippet showing tenant_id enforcement and access-control checks.

3) KMS: We integrate with cloud KMS (customer-managed option for Dedicated/Private). Default hosted flow uses a single managed key per region with envelope encryption; for enterprise customers we can provision per-customer keys.

Artifact: kms-key-policy-2026-03.txt (policy excerpt) and a short note describing when per-tenant keys are used.

4) Evidence of no cross-tenant access: we can provide
   - recent access review summary (redacted)
   - sample access-review CSV (access-review-redacted-sample.csv)
   - a short penetration test excerpt that specifically exercises tenant boundaries (if client NDA allows).

5) Deletion/retention: deletion requests trigger a job that marks and then purges data according to retention schedule; we will provide a redacted deletion log sample and the retention policy section.

ETA: we can stage artifacts today and have the Drive folder ready by Monday COB (10/11). The control-mapping sheet will map each SIG question to the artifact and list any residual gaps.

Let me know if we should generate additional verification (e.g., an isolated integration test run showing cross-tenant requests being blocked).

— Mina
Mina Haddad
Principal Platform Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Thompson <alice.thompson@lumenbank.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 12:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG: Tenant segmentation and data separation evidence request

Hi Alice — adding the security mapping context. We will provide a control mapping file that cross-references SIG questions to SOC 2 common criteria and ISO 27001 controls where applicable (examples: ISO A.9 user access, A.10 cryptographic controls, SOC2 — logical & physical access controls).

Artifacts we'll upload to the shared folder: 
- control-mapping-SIG-tenant.xlsx (sheet: mapping + notes)
- redacted access review sample (access-review-redacted-sample.csv)
- tenant-isolation-architecture-v2.pdf
- kms-key-policy-2026-03.txt

Notes on redactions and data sensitivity:
- Access logs and user-level events will be redacted; we will provide role/account-level evidence and time-windowed samples.
- KMS key identifiers will be redacted for hosted customers; for Dedicated/Private customers we can provide more granular key metadata under an executed NDA.

If LumenBank requires any cryptographic material (e.g., key wrapping proof), please flag that so we can route through infrastructure and legal.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference

Hi Alice — thanks for your patience. We uploaded the folder to the Drive link below and attached an inventory + control mapping. Summary of deliverables and next steps: 

Deliverables (shared folder: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/LumenBank-SIG-tenant-evidence)
- tenant-isolation-architecture-v2.pdf (diagram + model descriptions)
- control-mapping-SIG-tenant.xlsx (SIG Q -> SOC2/ISO mapping + artifact pointers)
- kms-key-policy-2026-03.txt (policy excerpt; sensitive identifiers redacted)
- access-review-redacted-sample.csv (role-level sample, last 90 days)
- sample-deletion-log-redacted.txt (example purge event)

Timing: we provided the folder and mapping today. If you want a 25–30 minute walkthrough, we can do Monday 10/12 at 10:30am PT.

Follow-ups: 
- If LumenBank needs per-tenant key IDs or unredacted pen-test excerpts, we'll need an executed NDA or existing contractual protections (please let us know which).
- We can generate an additional verification test run demonstrating blocked cross-tenant queries (30–60 minute engineering job) if the procurement team requires a test artifact.

Thanks — hope this helps your SIG review. Happy to adjust contents based on feedback from your assurance team.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
